scientific_integrity: Published stationary-current and classical Schur formulas are credited. New assertion is a fixed-total-density three-lane global/local optimal-allocation classification; it is a mathematical theorem of stationary signed currents, not a spontaneous dynamical symmetry-breaking claim.
scientific_limitations: The result fixes total mean density to one per longitudinal column and presumes independent sector choice; it does not analyze finite-size optimizer rounding, autonomous interlane transfer, transport fluctuations, or unrecorded earlier constrained optimizations.
title: Three-lane exclusion transport has two sharp allocation switches and a local-optimum coexistence window
